name: Formoterol
mechanism: Selective β2-adrenoreceptor agonist with rapid onset and long duration
dosing: Adults: 12mcg BD via dry powder inhaler. Max 48mcg daily. Always with ICS in asthma
contraindications: Hypersensitivity. Never use as monotherapy in asthma
monitoring: Peak flow, asthma control, heart rate, potassium (high doses)
sideEffects: Tremor, palpitations, headache, muscle cramps, hypokalemia
clinicalPearls: Rapid onset unlike salmeterol. Always combined with ICS. Available in combination inhalers
